title: Changing Requests or POs
body:
Changing Requests or POs

If you need to change a request or PO, you can do it after the PO reaches Ordered status. After your change has been approved, guided buying automatically sends the supplier a PO containing details of the change.

Prerequisites

If your SAP Ariba solution is integrated with an ERP system, ensure that the Use ERP purchase order number from database (Application.GuidedBuying.UseERPPONumberFromDB) parameter is enabled. This prevents change order failures caused by a missing ERP purchase order number in the integration message. For more information, see Use  ERP purchase order number from database.

Context

Consider the following when changing requests or POs:

  • You can change material or services items, quantities or amounts, or accounting information.

  • You can't change spot buy line items, because you pay for them immediately upon ordering; however, you can change accounting information.

  • To change items from a supplier's external site, go back to the site from the request. After you make changes on the site and check out again, the line item is changed in the request.

  • If you already received some of the ordered quantity or service, guided buying doesn't allow you to change the quantity to less than the amount you already received or serviced.

  • If you delete line items, they appear in the Canceled items section. You cannot delete lines that have been partially or fully received.

Procedure

  1. On the guided buying home page, choose Your requests.
  2. Scroll through the list of all types of requests (All) or filter by date. You can also use the Find a request search box to locate a request by one of the dropdown menu options: Request ID, Order ID, Request title, Supplier ID, or Supplier name. When using the search filters, the search returns any request that contains the searched string of text.
    Tip

    Items are sorted by the date they were last changed.

  3. Choose the request ID to open it.
  4. Choose Change request.
    Caution

    This button displays only after the request has reached Ordered state. It doesn't dispaly if the business processes defined in SAP Ariba Procurement solutions doesn't allow changes. For example, if changes aren't allowed after orders are shipped or received, of if the supplier doesn't allow changes.

  5. Choose Confirm in the confirmation dialog box.
  6. Optional: On the Checkout page, you can do any of the following:

    • Edit the line items and other information you want to change.

    • To add more items to the request, choose Continue shopping.
      Remember

      If the Continue shopping option isn't available, or if you're unable to delete items, it's because your organization doesn't allow it.

  7. Choose Check out to submit the changed request.

Results

The request displays the status Change in progress.

Guided buying appends the version number to the request ID; for example, PR100-V2. A change order is sent to the supplier to inform them about the changed item.
